author: PC Gamer
text:
First 5-day Tokyo Game Show in 30 years cuts back to 4 in face of Typhoon Dujuan
The gamer's traditional enemy, the typhoon.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Elden Ring Nightreign is dead, but modders are dabbing on its corpse, with one porting an entire Dark Souls 2 DLC zone as a playable map
A new spin on an old favorite.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Everything announced at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct 2026
Every single game and announcement, in the order they were shown.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take to the skies and shoot your mates in the face with a shotgun in Fish & Ships
These must be flying fish.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Feel like a kid again when toy car game Obstacle Overdrive launches October 2
Be careful or your car will tumble to the floor and wake your parents up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I lost hours to this roguelike card-based city builder even though I had no idea how all of those words could fit together
Boldly step into the mist and confront whatever horrors may emerge.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Solarpunk MMO Loftia is launching into early access November 3
Live on your very own island in the sky.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Unlock your inner Superman with a new demo from Undefeated: Genesis
Fly fast, shoot lasers from your eyes. You know? Superhero stuff.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Marked For Mayhem is a 4-player dungeon crawler that wants you to try to win as a team while also beating all your teammates as a player—good luck
I am being devoured by my own contradictions already.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Robots versus fungi FPS Mycopunk is leaving early access next month
Just enough time to gather your squad and prepare to deploy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Virtue and a Sledgehammer announces October 27 release date with another banger of a trailer
Do androids dream of electric construction tools?

author: PC Gamer
text:
The new game from Lorn's Lure's developer is also set in the creepy world, and this one's a horror flight sim
Take your plane and fly into the mist, just don't stray too far from the light.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Defend your farm from a gaze of raccoons in this charming tower defense roguelite, out tomorrow
Please don't make me fight the trash pandas, I love them.

author: PC Gamer
text:
We just saw a big chunk of Thief Remastered gameplay, and I'm more desperate than ever to play
Bafford's Manor is gonna be emptier than ever when I'm through with it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Core Keeper's Riders of the Underground update drops tomorrow, and you can get a sneak peek of it right here
A new sub-biome, mounts, and more.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Cairn's delayed On the Trail: Deep Water DLC gets a new release date, and you don't have long to wait
The climbing game is also 20% off on Steam.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Paper co-op deckbuilder Hellcard 2 has a new demo that you can play right now
Dive back into the paper dungeon and prepare to fight a whole lotta dragons.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dust till Dawn is a horror-themed clean-'em-up with music from Silent Hill's composer
Clean freaks.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Young Suns is an optimistic life sim for an unoptimistic time coming in November, and I'm already forming intense opinions about its cast of NPCs
I would die for Nora. Sorry not sorry.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Escape From Playtime is a co-op survival horror where you play itsy-bitsy toy animals, and its playtest is taking signups now
Many toy creatures will be harmed in the playing of this videogame.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Beautiful Freaks of the Desert is a speedrunning FPS flipping the middle finger at all things data center
A vibey trailer announced the game for the first time at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct

author: PC Gamer
text:
Memory is the map in Wane, a roguelike where each biome is a corner of an archaeologist's fading mind
An expedition unlike any other.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Lemonade Apocalypse has 3 simple tasks for you: Become a lemonade billionaire, 'fuel climate change,' and 'manipulate voters'
Can you do that?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Command a legion of robots in factory builder Brave New Wonders, launching tomorrow
Just write what you want them to do, easy as pie.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hello Sunshine's latest trailer has me even more excited for the giant robot game
"I'm always thirsty, my feet hurt." Same.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'AI could never make Tenebris Somnia,' the 2D retro survival horror with live-action cutscenes and practical effects
A game so emotionally scarring, "you'll call your ex."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Vaewolf's new story trailer takes us down a brutal path of revenge, and shows off the frenetic vampire and werewolf combat
Part vampire, part werewolf, part elf, all fury.

author: PC Gamer
text:
It's just you and your van in this upcoming open-world scavenging game
Be wary of what lurks in the fog that rolls in at night.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Neon Abyss 2 has a new final boss, a release date, and at least 1 massive fish worth many, many points
I like all of these things.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Pirate poker battler Piroker has a playtest you can sign up for now
Score big or walk the plank.
